Fonts are stored inside realOS. Select a card in the Settings font page and tap Apply to use it. Deleting the active font removes its stored file; the system keeps using the current slot copy until another font is selected.
Use fonts that cover the system language. Deleting the active font does not change the current system font; select another font in Settings to replace it.
